approved_prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Create a bold square desktop app icon concept for Beatstitch, a native desktop EDM DJ mixing application. Concept: SPLICED GROOVE. A single compact circular emblem: two offset semicircular vinyl-like groove arcs, fused by an elegant diagonal central seam with two broad stitch bridges. Communicate two songs becoming one flowing mix. Invent an original simple mark, not a realistic record photograph. Use just two thick clean arcs and the connecting bridges with generous dark negative space, visible at 32 pixels. One half saturated electric violet, the other warm amber-orange, on graphite-black. Rich precise enamel surface with subtle edge lighting and very limited depth; dramatic yet uncluttered. Center the emblem large, straight-on, square framing with comfortable equal margins. No words, labels, letters, text, music notes, headphones, generic play triangle, characters, mockup, contact sheet, extra objects, or watermark. A finished app-icon concept.

Use case: logo-brand / compositing.
Create a finished premium HORIZONTAL LOGO LOCKUP for Beatstitch, the desktop DJ mixing app, on a uniform opaque near-black charcoal background (#101116). Wide landscape canvas about 3:1.
Input image is the approved Spliced Groove symbol. Preserve the existing purple-left and orange-right circular halves, carved vinyl grooves, diagonal offset, two stitch connectors, proportions, and polished enamel finish. Keep this recognizable approved symbol intact at the left. It may be isolated visually against the charcoal canvas; no separate rounded-square tile.
To the right add exactly "BEATSTITCH" in a spectacular clean custom wordmark: wide bold extended geometric sans-serif, squared rounded counters, confident solid strokes, subtly chamfered terminals, precisely kerned. Upright electronic music lettering, professionally drawn, extremely legible. Make every glyph completely SOLID ivory-white (#F6F3E9), all letters unbroken. Smooth sharp outlines with ordinary antialiasing. The complete ten-letter spelling is B E A T S T I T C H; render one word without spaces. No grunge, scratches, distress, noise, white fragments, holes inside the solid strokes, thin outline effects, or missing letter parts. Wordmark cap height about 40% of symbol height; center it optically to the emblem with a comfortable gap.
The dark background must remain fully OPAQUE and uniform across the entire canvas, including all letter spaces. Emblem provides color and depth; lettering is elegantly flat. Generous clean margins. No transparency, no checkerboard, no vignette, no tagline, no other wording, no mockup, no watermark. Produce a single high-resolution finished lockup.

Use case: compositing / logo-brand. Image 1 is the approved clean horizontal Beatstitch logo lockup. Make a STACKED version by changing ONLY the placement and uniform scale of its elements. Keep exactly the same Spliced Groove emblem, purple/orange hues, two connectors, groove geometry, polished lighting, and exactly the same ivory-white BEATSTITCH lettering and font shapes. The complete word must remain spelled BEATSTITCH. Do not redraw the font or emblem. Place the emblem centered above the single-line wordmark on a square canvas, with a carefully balanced generous gap and clean margins. The emblem's width roughly half the wordmark width. Dark uniform opaque charcoal background (#101116), no tile around the emblem, no transparency. Crisp solid letters and smooth outlines, absolutely no distress, speckles, noise, missing strokes, or extra holes. No slogan, no other text, no mockup, no watermark. One beautiful finished stacked logo, high resolution.
